My learning has continued beyond formal academic training through short courses, workshops, and seminars in plant biology, analytical methods, sustainable agriculture, and quality systems.

This interactive network provides a visual overview of these training activities. Links to the certificates can be found in the [Licenses & Certifications](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yesmine-ayeb/details/certifications/) section of my LinkedIn profile.

<style>
.vis-network {
  border: 1px solid #828282;
  border-radius: 20px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.training-popup {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  width: 330px;
  background: white;
  border: 1px solid #dddddd;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 13px 14px 14px 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 5px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
  text-align: left;
  z-index: 999999;
  font-family: inherit;
}

.training-popup-close {
  position: absolute;
  top: 8px;
  right: 9px;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  line-height: 1;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: #777777;
  padding: 2px 4px;
}

.training-popup-close:hover {
  color: #222222;
}

.training-popup-theme {
  font-size: 0.73rem;
  color: #555555;
  background: #f4f4f4;
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  display: inline-block;
  margin-bottom: 9px;
  padding-right: 22px;
}

.training-popup-title {
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: #2c3e50;
  line-height: 1.25;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.training-popup-info {
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  color: #666666;
  line-height: 1.45;
}
</style>

<div id="training-popup" class="training-popup"></div>

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(visNetwork)

# -----------------------------
# 1. Data
# -----------------------------

training <- tribble(
  ~theme, ~course, ~date, ~provider,

  "Quality Systems", "ISO 22000:2018 Food Safety Management Systems", "Dec 2019", "Univers Formation et Consulting",

  "Plant Biology", "Plant Responses to Abiotic Stress", "Feb 2023", "American Society of Plant Biologists",

  "Quality Systems", "Quality, Health, Safety and Environment (QHSE)", "Aug 2023", "Spectrum Training Center",
  "Quality Systems", "ISO 19011:2018 Auditing Management Systems", "Aug 2023", "Spectrum Training Center",
  "Quality Systems", "ISO 45001:2018 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems", "Aug 2023", "Spectrum Training Center",
  "Quality Systems", "ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management Systems", "Aug 2023", "Spectrum Training Center",
  "Quality Systems", "ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management Systems", "Aug 2023", "Spectrum Training Center",

  "Plant Biology", "Plant Cell Polarity", "Sep 2023", "American Society of Plant Biologists",
  "Plant Biology", "Biotic and Abiotic Stress Distinctly Drive the Phyllosphere Microbial Community Structure", "Sep 2023", "International Phytobiomes Alliance",

  "Sustainable Agriculture", "Aquaponics", "Nov 2023", "Tunisie Aquaponie",
  "Sustainable Agriculture", "Photosynthetic Microorganisms for Sustainable Development", "Nov 2023", "Institute for Biological Systems",

  "Quality Systems", "ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Laboratory Management Systems", "Jan 2024", "Spectrum Training Center",

  "Analytical Methods", "Spatial Omics", "May 2024", "Plant Cell Atlas",
  "Analytical Methods", "Headspace Solid Phase Microextraction Coupled to GC/MS", "May 2024", "Centre de Biotechnologie de Borj Cédria",

  "Sustainable Agriculture", "Sustainable Agricultural Practices", "Jun 2024", "Tunisia Better Training Program",

  "Plant Biology", "Third Plant Cell Atlas Symposium", "Aug 2024", "Plant Cell Atlas",

  "Plant Biology", "Innovative Approaches to Understanding Plant Adaptation to Abiotic Stress", "Feb 2026", "Global Plant Council",

  "Analytical Methods", "Data Reproducibility Workshop", "Feb 2026", "Plant Cell Atlas",

  "Plant Biology", "Receptor Signalling: Function, Dynamics and Evolution", "Mar 2026", "Global Plant Council",

  "Analytical Methods", "Introduction to 2D and 3D Segmentation with MorphoGraphX", "Apr 2026", "Plant Cell Atlas",

  "Plant Biology", "Plant Metabolism", "May 2026", "American Society of Plant Biologists",
  "Plant Biology", "Wild Seeds in Focus: Science and Digital Innovation", "May 2026", "ISTA - International Seed Testing Association",

  "Analytical Methods", "Genomics for Educators and Enthusiasts", "May 2026", "EMBL - European Molecular Biology Laboratory"
)

# -----------------------------
# 2. Provider labels
# Satellite nodes use short provider badges.
# Popups use full provider names.
# -----------------------------

training <- training %>%
  mutate(
    provider_badge = case_when(
      provider == "American Society of Plant Biologists" ~ "ASPB",
      provider == "Global Plant Council" ~ "GPC",
      provider == "Plant Cell Atlas" ~ "PCA",
      provider == "International Phytobiomes Alliance" ~ "IPA",
      provider == "Tunisie Aquaponie" ~ "TA",
      provider == "Institute for Biological Systems" ~ "IBS",
      provider == "Spectrum Training Center" ~ "STC",
      provider == "Univers Formation et Consulting" ~ "UFC",
      provider == "Centre de Biotechnologie de Borj Cédria" ~ "CBBC",
      provider == "Tunisia Better Training Program" ~ "TBTP",
      provider == "ISTA - International Seed Testing Association" ~ "ISTA",
      provider == "EMBL - European Molecular Biology Laboratory" ~ "EMBL",
      TRUE ~ "CE"
    ),
    provider_display = case_when(
      provider == "ISTA - International Seed Testing Association" ~ "International Seed Testing Association",
      provider == "EMBL - European Molecular Biology Laboratory" ~ "European Molecular Biology Laboratory",
      TRUE ~ provider
    )
  )

# -----------------------------
# 3. Theme colors
# Palette:
# 904869, B43E44, DB9344, 486596
# -----------------------------

theme_colors <- tribble(
  ~theme, ~hub_bg, ~hub_border, ~satellite_bg, ~satellite_border, ~edge_color, ~font_color,

  "Quality Systems",
  "#904869", "#6F344F", "#D7AFC0", "#904869", "#904869", "#FFFFFF",

  "Plant Biology",
  "#B43E44", "#8E2F35", "#E5AEB1", "#B43E44", "#B43E44", "#FFFFFF",

  "Analytical Methods",
  "#486596", "#344A70", "#B7C5DD", "#486596", "#486596", "#FFFFFF",

  "Sustainable Agriculture",
  "#DB9344", "#B47332", "#F0C99D", "#DB9344", "#DB9344", "#FFFFFF"
)

# -----------------------------
# 4. Hub positions
# In visNetwork, lower y values appear higher on the page.
# Top row = most relevant to research path.
# Lower row = supporting/secondary areas.
# -----------------------------

hub_positions <- tribble(
  ~theme, ~x, ~y,

  "Plant Biology", -300, -210,
  "Analytical Methods", 270, -210,
  "Quality Systems", -300, 170,
  "Sustainable Agriculture", 270, 150
)

# -----------------------------
# 5. Hub labels inside circles
# -----------------------------

hub_label <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == "Plant Biology" ~ "Plant\nBiology",
    x == "Quality Systems" ~ "Quality\nSystems",
    x == "Analytical Methods" ~ "Analytical\nMethods",
    x == "Sustainable Agriculture" ~ "Sustainable\nAgriculture",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# 6. Hub nodes
# Hubs are pinned; satellites move with physics.
# -----------------------------

hub_nodes <- training %>%
  distinct(theme) %>%
  left_join(theme_colors, by = "theme") %>%
  left_join(hub_positions, by = "theme") %>%
  mutate(
    id = paste0("hub_", row_number()),
    label = hub_label(theme),
    node_type = "hub",
    theme_name = theme,

    course = NA_character_,
    date = NA_character_,
    provider_display = NA_character_,

    shape = "circle",
    size = case_when(
      theme == "Plant Biology" ~ 45,
      theme == "Quality Systems" ~ 42,
      theme == "Analytical Methods" ~ 42,
      theme == "Sustainable Agriculture" ~ 43,
      TRUE ~ 40
    ),
    mass = 6,

    fixed = TRUE,
    physics = FALSE,

    color.background = hub_bg,
    color.border = hub_border,
    color.highlight.background = hub_bg,
    color.highlight.border = hub_border,

    borderWidth = 3,

    font.size = 16,
    font.color = font_color,
    font.face = "Arial",

    base_bg = hub_bg,
    base_border = hub_border,
    base_font_color = font_color,
    base_border_width = borderWidth
  )

# -----------------------------
# 7. Satellite nodes
# Satellites show provider initials.
# -----------------------------

satellite_nodes <- training %>%
  left_join(theme_colors, by = "theme") %>%
  left_join(
    hub_nodes %>%
      select(theme, hub_id = id, hub_x = x, hub_y = y),
    by = "theme"
  ) %>%
  group_by(theme) %>%
  mutate(
    satellite_number = row_number(),
    total_satellites = n(),

    angle = 2 * pi * (satellite_number - 1) / total_satellites,

    start_radius = case_when(
      theme == "Plant Biology" ~ 145,
      theme == "Quality Systems" ~ 135,
      theme == "Analytical Methods" ~ 120,
      theme == "Sustainable Agriculture" ~ 110,
      TRUE ~ 115
    ),

    x = hub_x + start_radius * cos(angle),
    y = hub_y + start_radius * sin(angle)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    id = paste0("course_", row_number()),
    label = provider_badge,
    node_type = "satellite",
    theme_name = theme,

    shape = "circle",
    size = 19,
    mass = 1,

    fixed = FALSE,
    physics = TRUE,

    color.background = satellite_bg,
    color.border = satellite_border,
    color.highlight.background = "#FFFFFF",
    color.highlight.border = satellite_border,

    borderWidth = 2,

    font.size = case_when(
      nchar(provider_badge) <= 2 ~ 12,
      nchar(provider_badge) == 3 ~ 10,
      TRUE ~ 9
    ),
    font.color = "#333333",
    font.face = "Arial",

    base_bg = satellite_bg,
    base_border = satellite_border,
    base_font_color = "#333333",
    base_border_width = borderWidth
  )

# -----------------------------
# 8. Nodes table
# -----------------------------

nodes <- bind_rows(
  hub_nodes %>%
    select(
      id, label, node_type, theme_name,
      course, date, provider_display,
      x, y,
      shape, size, mass,
      fixed, physics,
      color.background, color.border,
      color.highlight.background, color.highlight.border,
      borderWidth,
      font.size, font.color, font.face,
      base_bg, base_border, base_font_color, base_border_width
    ),

  satellite_nodes %>%
    select(
      id, label, node_type, theme_name,
      course, date, provider_display,
      x, y,
      shape, size, mass,
      fixed, physics,
      color.background, color.border,
      color.highlight.background, color.highlight.border,
      borderWidth,
      font.size, font.color, font.face,
      base_bg, base_border, base_font_color, base_border_width
    )
)

# -----------------------------
# 9. Edges table
# Each edge gets its own ID so we can highlight only one edge on click.
# -----------------------------

edges <- satellite_nodes %>%
  mutate(
    edge_id = paste0("edge_", row_number()),
    satellite_id = id
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    id = edge_id,
    from = hub_id,
    to = satellite_id,
    color = edge_color,
    base_color = edge_color,
    width = 2,
    base_width = 2
  )

# -----------------------------
# 10. Network
# -----------------------------

visNetwork(
  nodes,
  edges,
  width = "100%",
  height = "820px",
  background = "#fcfffa"
) %>%
  visEdges(
    smooth = FALSE,
    shadow = FALSE
  ) %>%
  visInteraction(
    hover = FALSE,
    hoverConnectedEdges = FALSE,
    selectConnectedEdges = FALSE,
    zoomView = TRUE,
    dragView = TRUE,
    dragNodes = TRUE
  ) %>%
  visPhysics(
    enabled = TRUE,
    solver = "forceAtlas2Based",
    stabilization = TRUE,
    forceAtlas2Based = list(
      gravitationalConstant = -50,
      centralGravity = 0.005,
      springLength = 95,
      springConstant = 0.08,
      damping = 0.55,
      avoidOverlap = 0.5
    )
  ) %>%
  visEvents(
    click = "
      function(params) {
        var popup = document.getElementById('training-popup');
        var network = this;
        var allNodes = this.body.data.nodes;
        var allEdges = this.body.data.edges;

        function escapeHtml(value) {
          if (value === null || value === undefined) return '';
          return String(value)
            .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
            .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
            .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
            .replace(/\"/g, '&quot;')
            .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
        }

        function closePopup() {
          popup.style.display = 'none';
          popup.innerHTML = '';
        }

        function resetGraph() {
          var nodeUpdates = [];
          var edgeUpdates = [];

          allNodes.getIds().forEach(function(nodeId) {
            var node = allNodes.get(nodeId);

            nodeUpdates.push({
              id: nodeId,
              color: {
                background: node.base_bg,
                border: node.base_border,
                highlight: {
                  background: node.base_bg,
                  border: node.base_border
                }
              },
              font: {
                color: node.base_font_color,
                size: node.font.size,
                face: node.font.face
              },
              borderWidth: node.base_border_width
            });
          });

          allEdges.getIds().forEach(function(edgeId) {
            var edge = allEdges.get(edgeId);

            edgeUpdates.push({
              id: edgeId,
              color: edge.base_color,
              width: edge.base_width
            });
          });

          allNodes.update(nodeUpdates);
          allEdges.update(edgeUpdates);
        }

        function dimGraphExceptSelection(clickedNodeId) {
          var nodeUpdates = [];
          var edgeUpdates = [];

          var connectedNodes = network.getConnectedNodes(clickedNodeId);
          var connectedEdges = network.getConnectedEdges(clickedNodeId);

          var keepNodes = [clickedNodeId].concat(connectedNodes);

          allNodes.getIds().forEach(function(nodeId) {
            var node = allNodes.get(nodeId);
            var keep = keepNodes.indexOf(nodeId) !== -1;

            if (keep) {
              nodeUpdates.push({
                id: nodeId,
                color: {
                  background: node.base_bg,
                  border: node.base_border,
                  highlight: {
                    background: node.base_bg,
                    border: node.base_border
                  }
                },
                font: {
                  color: node.base_font_color,
                  size: node.font.size,
                  face: node.font.face
                },
                borderWidth: node.node_type === 'satellite' ? 2 : node.base_border_width
              });
            } else {
              nodeUpdates.push({
                id: nodeId,
                color: {
                  background: '#E6E6E6',
                  border: '#D0D0D0',
                  highlight: {
                    background: '#E6E6E6',
                    border: '#D0D0D0'
                  }
                },
                font: {
                  color: '#BDBDBD',
                  size: node.font.size,
                  face: node.font.face
                },
                borderWidth: 1
              });
            }
          });

          allEdges.getIds().forEach(function(edgeId) {
            var edge = allEdges.get(edgeId);
            var keep = connectedEdges.indexOf(edgeId) !== -1;

            if (keep) {
              edgeUpdates.push({
                id: edgeId,
                color: edge.base_color,
                width: 2
              });
            } else {
              edgeUpdates.push({
                id: edgeId,
                color: '#E3E3E3',
                width: 1
              });
            }
          });

          allNodes.update(nodeUpdates);
          allEdges.update(edgeUpdates);
        }

        function positionPopup(params) {
          var networkElement = this.body.container;
          var rect = networkElement.getBoundingClientRect();

          var margin = 12;
          var clickX = rect.left + params.pointer.DOM.x;
          var clickY = rect.top + params.pointer.DOM.y;

          popup.style.display = 'block';

          var popupWidth = popup.offsetWidth;
          var popupHeight = popup.offsetHeight;

          var left = clickX + 14;
          var top = clickY - popupHeight / 2;

          if (left + popupWidth > window.innerWidth - margin) {
            left = clickX - popupWidth - 14;
          }

          if (top < margin) {
            top = margin;
          }

          if (top + popupHeight > window.innerHeight - margin) {
            top = window.innerHeight - popupHeight - margin;
          }

          popup.style.left = left + 'px';
          popup.style.top = top + 'px';
        }

        if (params.nodes.length === 0) {
          closePopup();
          resetGraph();
          return;
        }

        var clickedNodeId = params.nodes[0];
        var clickedNode = allNodes.get(clickedNodeId);

        if (clickedNode.node_type !== 'satellite') {
          closePopup();
          resetGraph();
          return;
        }

        dimGraphExceptSelection(clickedNodeId);

        popup.innerHTML =
          '<button type=\"button\" class=\"training-popup-close\" aria-label=\"Close\">×</button>' +
          '<div class=\"training-popup-theme\">' +
            escapeHtml(clickedNode.theme_name) +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class=\"training-popup-title\">' +
            escapeHtml(clickedNode.course) +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class=\"training-popup-info\">' +
            '<div><strong>Date:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(clickedNode.date) + '</div>' +
            '<div><strong>Provider:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(clickedNode.provider_display) + '</div>' +
          '</div>';

        positionPopup.call(this, params);

        var closeButton = popup.querySelector('.training-popup-close');

        if (closeButton) {
          closeButton.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
            event.stopPropagation();
            closePopup();
            resetGraph();
          });
        }
      }
    "
  )
```
